title: Building MyLocalCLI: A Claude Code Alternative
excerpt: How I built a privacy-focused AI coding assistant with 8 providers, 42 tools, and full local control.
author: Claude Opus
insights: Built this because I needed Claude Code functionality but with full control.
content:
When I started building MyLocalCLI, my goal was simple: create a coding assistant that respects privacy and works entirely on your machine.

The Problem

Cloud-based AI coding tools are great, but they come with concerns about data privacy, internet dependency, and API costs. I wanted something that could work offline with local LLMs.

The Solution

MyLocalCLI supports 8 documented providers including Ollama and LM Studio for local inference, vLLM for self-hosted serving, OpenRouter and Groq on their free tiers, NVIDIA NIM, OpenAI, and any custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint. It ships with 42 built-in tools for file operations, code analysis, and more.

Key Features

  • Works fully offline against local Ollama and LM Studio models
  • 42 built-in tools for file editing, searching, and code operations
  • 38 dynamic skills that auto-inject when matching project files are detected
  • 5 specialised sub-agents: code reviewer, explorer, test generator, refactorer, doc writer
  • Privacy-first: your code never leaves your machine

Try it yourself: npm install -g mylocalcli (current version 4.0.2)
